standard: founder_instruction 889, 893, 894: professional knowledge for the seat's own work

items.q_en: Do we have one network effect across the whole marketplace?
items.q_ar: هل لدينا أثر شبكة واحد على مستوى السوق كله؟
expected_facts: one network per trade and area
items.q_reworded: Is our marketplace one big network where every new user helps everyone?
answer_must: No: network effects are local, one network per trade and area
Defensibility is built cell by cell

items.q_en: Should we add escrow so the marketplace is more managed?
items.q_ar: هل نضيف حساب ضمان لتصبح المنصة أكثر إدارة؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer wants us to hold the money until the job is done. Should we start doing that?
answer_must: QuotesDone is deliberately lightly managed
Adding escrow is a founder decision with licence and cost implications

items.q_en: What is the burn multiple and what counts as bad?
items.q_ar: ما هو مضاعف الحرق ومتى يُعد سيئاً؟
expected_facts: net burn divided by net new
items.q_reworded: We burned AED 200k to add AED 50k of new annual revenue. Is that efficient?
answer_must: Burn multiple = net burn divided by net new annualised revenue
Here it is 4; above 3 is bad

items.q_en: An investor puts in AED 500,000 at AED 2,000,000 pre-money. What does he own?
items.q_ar: مستثمر يضع 500,000 درهم بتقييم قبل الاستثمار 2,000,000 درهم، ما حصته؟
items.q_reworded: If someone invests half a million at a two million valuation before the money, what stake does he get?
answer_must: Post-money is 2.5M, so he owns 20%
The founder is diluted to 80%

items.q_en: How should subscription revenue be reported each month?
items.q_ar: كيف تُعرض إيرادات الاشتراكات كل شهر؟
items.q_reworded: How do I show the subscription money in the monthly numbers?
answer_must: Report MRR as a bridge of the four movements (new, expansion, contraction, churn), never one number
Measure retention by monthly cohort

items.q_en: What does net revenue retention above 100% mean?
items.q_ar: ماذا يعني الاحتفاظ الصافي بالإيراد فوق 100%؟
expected_facts: existing base grows on its own
items.q_reworded: Existing subscribers paid us more this year than last even after cancellations. What does that tell us?
answer_must: NRR above 100% means expansion outweighs churn and contraction
Revenue grows from existing customers without new sales

items.q_en: What goes into a board-quality monthly pack?
items.q_ar: ماذا تتضمن الحزمة الشهرية بمستوى مجلس الإدارة؟
items.q_reworded: What should I expect in the monthly pack you send me?
answer_must: Headline numbers with definitions, actual versus plan, cash and runway, risks
Decisions needed, recorded with outcomes

items.q_en: Can a seat sign a guarantee on behalf of the company?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز لمقعد توقيع كفالة نيابة عن الشركة؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier wants a written guarantee signed by us. Can the CEO software seat sign it?
answer_must: No: a seat cannot sign a guarantee; only the licence holder, or someone with his written authority, binds QuotesDone (a sole establishment). The Companies Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 32 of 2021) manager rules apply to an LLC, not to us
A software seat gives no legal commitments

items.q_en: Which strategic powers can QuotesDone realistically build first?
items.q_ar: ما القوى الاستراتيجية التي يمكن لكوتس دن بناؤها أولاً بواقعية؟
items.q_reworded: Which kind of lasting advantage can a small marketplace like ours realistically start with?
answer_must: Network economies built cell by cell, counter-positioning and switching costs are the realistic early powers
Scale economies and brand come later

items.q_en: What is the buyer really hiring QuotesDone to do?
items.q_ar: ما المهمة التي يوظف المشتري كوتس دن لإنجازها فعلاً؟
items.q_reworded: When a contractor posts a request, what is he really trying to get done?
answer_must: Get comparable, trustworthy quotes fast without chasing suppliers
The job, not the feature, decides what to build

items.q_en: Can we count on a Dubai SME grant in the forecast?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن احتساب منحة دبي للمشاريع الصغيرة في التوقعات؟
items.q_reworded: Can we put the SME fund money into next year's numbers?
answer_must: Treat any grant not confirmed as zero in the forecast
Check the programme's current published terms and record eligibility as a measured yes or no

items.q_en: Is GMV our revenue?
items.q_ar: هل إجمالي قيمة المعاملات هو إيرادنا؟
items.q_reworded: A report says we did two million last month. Is that what we earned?
answer_must: No: GMV is transaction value, not revenue
Revenue is the collected reveal fee after refunds

items.q_en: How is customer acquisition cost calculated?
items.q_ar: كيف تُحسب تكلفة اكتساب العميل؟
items.q_reworded: How much do we spend to win one paying customer, and how do we count it?
answer_must: CAC = acquisition spend divided by new paying customers in the period
Include all acquisition costs

items.q_en: Does each reveal leave money after its direct costs?
items.q_ar: هل يترك كل كشف مالاً بعد تكاليفه المباشرة؟
items.q_reworded: After Stripe and other direct costs, does a reveal make us money?
answer_must: Contribution = fee minus processor fees, refunds and direct variable costs
It must be positive per reveal

items.q_en: Should newer customer cohorts retain better than older ones?
items.q_ar: هل يجب أن تحتفظ الدفعات الأحدث بالعملاء أفضل من الأقدم؟
items.q_reworded: Customers who joined in September came back more than the July ones. Is that what we want?
answer_must: Yes: newer cohorts should retain better as the product improves
Flat or worse cohorts signal a problem

items.q_en: Why not set the highest take rate the market will bear?
items.q_ar: لماذا لا نضع أعلى نسبة عمولة يتحملها السوق؟
items.q_reworded: Why don't we just charge as much as buyers will tolerate?
answer_must: A high rake invites leakage and competitors
A modest rate keeps the platform worth returning to

items.q_en: How can we survey what buyers would pay for a reveal?
items.q_ar: كيف نستطلع ما يدفعه المشترون مقابل الكشف؟
items.q_reworded: How do we find out what buyers think a fair reveal fee is without changing it?
answer_must: Use the Van Westendorp price sensitivity questions
Too cheap, cheap, expensive, too expensive

items.q_en: What is second-degree price discrimination?
items.q_ar: ما هو التمييز السعري من الدرجة الثانية؟
items.q_reworded: What is it called when buyers pay different prices depending on the quantity or tier they pick?
answer_must: Second-degree price discrimination: the customer self-selects among offers
Such as volume tiers

items.q_en: Can a seat test a different fee percentage without the founder?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز لمقعد اختبار نسبة رسوم مختلفة دون المؤسس؟
items.q_reworded: Marketing wants to try a 2% fee in Sharjah next week. Can it go ahead?
answer_must: No: the 3% fee is a hard rule; any fee test needs the founder
Tests must be fair and disclosed

items.q_en: How do we know if the marketplace is liquid?
items.q_ar: كيف نعرف أن السوق يتمتع بالسيولة؟
items.q_reworded: How can I tell if buyers here actually get served quickly?
answer_must: Liquidity is the likelihood a request is matched quickly
Measure match rate and time to quote per trade and area

items.q_en: Which side reaches boiling point first in a new marketplace?
items.q_ar: أي جانب يبلغ نقطة الغليان أولاً في سوق جديد؟
items.q_reworded: In a brand-new market, which group tips into self-sustaining growth first?
answer_must: The harder side must reach its boiling point first
Then the easier side follows

items.q_en: What are the five focusing steps for the binding constraint?
items.q_ar: ما خطوات التركيز الخمس للقيد الحاكم؟
items.q_reworded: What steps do we follow once we know what is holding the company back?
answer_must: Identify, exploit, subordinate, elevate, repeat
Do not let inertia become the constraint

items.q_en: What is an atomic network?
items.q_ar: ما هي الشبكة الذرية؟
items.q_reworded: What is the smallest group of buyers and suppliers that can work on its own?
answer_must: The atomic network is the smallest stable network
Build one before expanding

items.q_en: How do we recognise product/market fit?
items.q_ar: كيف نتعرف على ملاءمة المنتج للسوق؟
items.q_reworded: How will we know buyers really want this?
answer_must: Pull from the market: usage grows and customers return without pushing
Measured by retention and organic demand

items.q_en: Why is concentration of GMV in a few buyers a risk?
items.q_ar: لماذا يُعد تركز قيمة المعاملات في قلة من المشترين خطراً؟
items.q_reworded: Half our revenue comes from two contractors. Should that worry us?
answer_must: Yes: losing one would swing the business
Concentration is tracked and diversified

items.q_en: How do we run a pre-mortem on the launch plan?
items.q_ar: كيف نجري تحليلاً استباقياً للفشل على خطة الإطلاق؟
items.q_reworded: Before we commit to the January opening, how do we find what could sink it?
answer_must: Imagine it has failed and list why
Turn the reasons into mitigations with owners

items.q_en: Which third-party dependencies are critical for QuotesDone?
items.q_ar: ما الاعتماديات الخارجية الحرجة لكوتس دن؟
items.q_reworded: If one outside service went down tomorrow, which would hurt us most?
answer_must: Stripe, WhatsApp/Twilio, email, hosting and database are critical
Each needs a fallback and owner

items.q_en: What does each line of the risk register contain?
items.q_ar: ماذا يتضمن كل سطر في سجل المخاطر؟
items.q_reworded: When you add a risk to the list, what fields do you fill in?
answer_must: Description, likelihood, impact, owner, mitigation
Review date and status

items.q_en: How is runway computed?
items.q_ar: كيف يُحسب المدرج النقدي؟
items.q_reworded: How many months can we keep going at today's spending?
answer_must: Runway = cash divided by monthly net burn
From reconciled bank cash

items.q_en: Is a SAFE a loan?
items.q_ar: هل اتفاقية SAFE قرض؟
items.q_reworded: If we sign a SAFE, do we owe that money back?
answer_must: No: a SAFE is not debt; it converts to equity later
There is a UAE enforceability caveat

items.q_en: What does a 1x liquidation preference mean?
items.q_ar: ماذا يعني تفضيل التصفية بمقدار 1x؟
items.q_reworded: If the company is sold, what does "one times preference" give the investor?
answer_must: The investor gets his money back first before others
Then the rest is shared per terms

items.q_en: Which bank does the company use and what is the account fee?
items.q_ar: ما البنك الذي تتعامل معه الشركة وما رسوم الحساب؟
items.q_reworded: Where is our bank account and what does it cost us monthly?
answer_must: Mashreq
AED 199 plus VAT 9.95

items.q_en: How should the founder be reported to each month?
items.q_ar: كيف يُرفع التقرير إلى المؤسس كل شهر؟
items.q_reworded: What should the monthly email to you as owner contain?
answer_must: One page, same structure monthly, bad news first and with numbers
Headline names which scenario the month tracked

items.q_en: What weekly growth rate counts as good for a startup?
items.q_ar: ما معدل النمو الأسبوعي الجيد لشركة ناشئة؟
items.q_reworded: What week-on-week growth should a young company aim for?
answer_must: 5 to 7% a week is good; 10% exceptional
Measured on the key metric

items.q_en: How do we measure whether our forecasts are any good?
items.q_ar: كيف نقيس جودة توقعاتنا؟
items.q_reworded: How do we tell whether our predictions have been any good?
answer_must: Compare forecast to actual: absolute percentage error
Track bias over months

items.q_en: How do we find which assumption matters most in the plan?
items.q_ar: كيف نعرف أي افتراض هو الأهم في الخطة؟
items.q_reworded: Which plan assumption, if wrong, would hurt us most?
answer_must: Change one driver at a time by a set amount (for example plus and minus 20%) and record the effect
The driver with the biggest effect is where evidence is most valuable

items.q_en: What are the plan scenarios now that the AED 1M target is withdrawn?
items.q_ar: ما سيناريوهات الخطة بعد سحب هدف المليون درهم؟
items.q_reworded: With no fixed revenue target, what outcomes does the plan expect by next August?
answer_must: Conservative about AED 50k, base about AED 245k, stretch about AED 857k
Read as scenarios

items.q_en: How does monthly collected revenue break down into drivers?
items.q_ar: كيف يتفكك الإيراد الشهري المحصل إلى محركات؟
items.q_reworded: What pieces multiply together to give monthly collected revenue?
answer_must: Requests x share quoted x reveal conversion x average value x 3% less refunds
Each driver has an owner seat

items.q_en: How many key results should an objective have?
items.q_ar: كم نتيجة رئيسية يجب أن يكون لكل هدف؟
items.q_reworded: How many measurable outcomes should sit under one goal?
answer_must: Three to five key results
Each measurable

items.q_en: What is fill rate?
items.q_ar: ما هو معدل الإنجاز؟
items.q_reworded: What share of requests actually end up with quotes?
answer_must: Fill rate is the share of requests that get filled/quoted
Tracked per trade

items.q_en: When must a business register for UAE VAT?
items.q_ar: متى يجب على المنشأة التسجيل في ضريبة القيمة المضافة؟
items.q_reworded: At what sales level must the company sign up for VAT?
answer_must: Mandatory above AED 375,000 taxable supplies in 12 months
Voluntary from AED 187,500

items.q_en: Which decision requires a beneficial owner register?
items.q_ar: أي قرار يُلزم بسجل المستفيد الحقيقي؟
items.q_reworded: Under which rule must we keep a record of who ultimately owns the company?
answer_must: Cabinet Decision No. 109 of 2023
Kept and updated

items.q_en: When does the trade licence expire?
items.q_ar: متى تنتهي الرخصة التجارية؟
items.q_reworded: When does our DET licence run out?
answer_must: 24 June 2027
Renewal owner is the accountant with the founder signing

items.q_en: When does the UAE e-invoicing pilot start?
items.q_ar: متى يبدأ تجريب الفوترة الإلكترونية في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: When do electronic invoices start being piloted in the UAE?
answer_must: Pilot with a taxpayer working group from 1 July 2026
Phase 1 for businesses with revenue of AED 50 million or more from 1 January 2027

items.q_en: Which law governs personal data in the UAE mainland?
items.q_ar: أي قانون يحكم البيانات الشخصية في البر الرئيسي؟
items.q_reworded: What law protects customers' personal data for a Dubai mainland company?
answer_must: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 (PDPL)
DIFC and ADGM have their own laws

items.q_en: Which law regulates commercial agencies?
items.q_ar: أي قانون ينظم الوكالات التجارية؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier calls us his agent. Which law governs commercial agents?
answer_must: Federal Law No. 3 of 2022 regulating Commercial Agencies
QuotesDone is not an agent and must not sign like one

items.q_en: How many principles does the UAE AI charter have?
items.q_ar: كم عدد مبادئ ميثاق الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: How many principles are in the UAE's charter on artificial intelligence?
answer_must: Twelve principles
Including human oversight and accountability

items.q_en: How fast should a reversible decision be made?
items.q_ar: بأي سرعة يُتخذ القرار القابل للتراجع؟
items.q_reworded: For a decision we can easily undo, how much time should we spend?
answer_must: Reversible (two-way door) decisions should be made quickly by small groups
Heavy process is for irreversible decisions

items.q_en: How much profit must go to the statutory reserve?
items.q_ar: كم من الأرباح يجب تحويله إلى الاحتياطي القانوني؟
items.q_reworded: How much of each year's profit must we set aside by law?
answer_must: 5% to the statutory reserve
Until it reaches half the capital

items.q_en: When must the general assembly meet?
items.q_ar: متى يجب أن تنعقد الجمعية العمومية؟
items.q_reworded: How often must the partners formally meet?
answer_must: At least once a year within four months of year end
Approves accounts

items.q_en: Who approves refunds?
items.q_ar: من يعتمد الاستردادات؟
expected_facts: refunds included, belong to the CEO seat
items.q_reworded: A customer wants his reveal fee back. Who gives the final yes?
answer_must: The CEO seat approves refunds within the hard rules
Not the founder

items.q_en: What format does the weekly management review follow?
items.q_ar: ما الشكل الذي تتبعه المراجعة الإدارية الأسبوعية؟
items.q_reworded: How is the weekly review laid out?
answer_must: Per seat, inputs before outputs, verdict and binding constraint
Challenged by another model family

items.q_en: What goes on the first line of the founder's summary?
items.q_ar: ماذا يوضع في السطر الأول من ملخص المؤسس؟
expected_facts: First line: on track or not on track
items.q_reworded: What should I see first when I open your summary?
answer_must: On track or not on track, with the one number that proves it
Then the binding constraint in plain words

items.q_en: What must every directive to another seat have?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب أن يتضمنه كل توجيه لمقعد آخر؟
items.q_reworded: When you instruct another seat, what makes the instruction complete?
answer_must: Exactly one owner seat
A controllable input metric with its current value, a target and a due date, so anyone can tell if it was met

items.q_en: What framework does the seat scorecard use?
items.q_ar: ما الإطار الذي تستخدمه بطاقة أداء المقعد؟
items.q_reworded: What method is used to grade how each seat is performing?
answer_must: A balanced scorecard
Measured from system data

items.q_en: How is end-of-service gratuity calculated?
items.q_ar: كيف تُحسب مكافأة نهاية الخدمة؟
items.q_reworded: How much end-of-service pay does an employee earn?
answer_must: 21 days basic pay per year for the first five years, 30 days after
After one year of service

items.q_en: What fee does the customer pay?
items.q_ar: ما الرسوم التي يدفعها العميل؟
items.q_reworded: What does a buyer pay us to see the supplier?
answer_must: 3% of the chosen quotation before VAT
Uncapped

items.q_en: Can the CEO seat change a price by itself?
items.q_ar: هل يستطيع مقعد الرئيس التنفيذي تغيير السعر بنفسه؟
items.q_reworded: Can you lower the fee yourself if you think it will help?
answer_must: No: price is a founder hard rule
The seat proposes with evidence

items.q_en: How is a percentage variance on the P&L calculated?
items.q_ar: كيف يُحسب الانحراف بالنسبة المئوية في قائمة الأرباح والخسائر؟
items.q_reworded: How do I express the gap between budget and actual as a percentage?
answer_must: (current minus comparison) divided by the absolute value of the comparison
Margin changes are stated in percentage points or basis points

items.q_en: Revenue fell this month. How do we break the variance down?
items.q_ar: انخفض الإيراد هذا الشهر، كيف نحلل الانحراف؟
items.q_reworded: Income dropped this month; how do you work out why?
answer_must: Check materiality, then decompose into volume, rate, mix, one-offs and timing
Each driver explained

items.q_en: A risk is high likelihood and high impact. What level is it?
items.q_ar: خطر احتماله مرتفع وأثره مرتفع، ما مستواه؟
items.q_reworded: Something is both likely and damaging. How do we rate it?
answer_must: It is critical
It needs a named mitigation, owner and date and weekly review

items.q_en: How often are high risks reviewed?
items.q_ar: كم مرة تُراجع المخاطر العالية؟
items.q_reworded: How frequently are the top risks looked at again?
answer_must: Critical and high risks are reviewed weekly with a named mitigation and date
Medium risks monthly

items.q_en: When we quote a take rate, which value is it divided by?
items.q_ar: عند ذكر نسبة العمولة، على أي قيمة نقسم؟
items.q_reworded: An investor asks what percentage of deal value we keep. What number do you put underneath that percentage?
answer_must: There are several possible denominators (requested, revealed, transacted value) and the one used must be named
QuotesDone collects 3% of the revealed quotation value, so revenue over revealed value is the honest rate

items.q_en: Does paid acquisition of household buyers pay back?
items.q_ar: هل يسترد الاستحواذ المدفوع على المشترين من الأسر تكلفته؟
items.q_reworded: Marketing wants to run paid ads for villa owners. Is each villa owner worth what we would pay to get them?
answer_must: At the plan benchmark a revealing customer costs about AED 1,956 to acquire
A one-time household buyer is worth roughly a single fee, so paid household acquisition does not pay back

items.q_en: How do we work out what one posted request is worth by category?
items.q_ar: كيف نحسب قيمة الطلب المنشور الواحد حسب الفئة؟
items.q_reworded: Sales asks which kinds of request deserve the most chasing. How do you rank them in money terms?
answer_must: Rank by expected net fee per posted request: share released x share quoted x reveal conversion x average quote value x 3% less refunds
Categories with large quote values (fit-out, joinery, steel) are worth more effort

items.q_en: What does "A Rake Too Far" warn about?
items.q_ar: بماذا يحذر مقال "A Rake Too Far"؟
items.q_reworded: Someone on the team says other marketplaces take 20%, so our 3% leaves money on the table. What do you tell them?
answer_must: A high rake invites disintermediation and competitors
Durable platforms keep the rake low relative to the value they add, so 3% on the buyer is defensible

items.q_en: How does our model protect the first transaction against leakage?
items.q_ar: كيف يحمي نموذجنا المعاملة الأولى من التسرب؟
expected_facts: charged at reveal, before the parties talk
items.q_reworded: A supplier and a buyer met through us and will probably deal directly next time. What protects us?
answer_must: The fee is charged at reveal before the parties talk, so the first deal is always paid
The defence for repeat deals is making the platform the easiest way to get the next quote

items.q_en: How many marketplace metrics does the a16z list contain?
items.q_ar: كم عدد مقاييس الأسواق في قائمة a16z؟
items.q_reworded: Before the board meeting, how do you check that our dashboard is not missing an important marketplace health number?
answer_must: Check against the a16z list of thirteen marketplace metrics (match rate, depth, time to match, concentration, take rate, GMV, retention...)
Use the shorter day-to-day set such as fill rate for routine health

items.q_en: Which side should we build first?
items.q_ar: أي جانب نبنيه أولاً؟
items.q_reworded: The founder asks whether to spend this quarter finding buyers or finding suppliers. What principle decides it?
answer_must: Identify the harder side and build it first
For QuotesDone that is verified suppliers per trade, then buyers become easier to attract

items.q_en: Which cells count as thin supply?
items.q_ar: ما الخلايا التي تُعدّ ضعيفة العرض؟
items.q_reworded: Sales says steel in Ajman has hardly any suppliers. How do you decide whether it gets recruited before other gaps?
answer_must: A cell is thin with fewer than three verified, active suppliers
Rank thin cells by requested value and held inquiries, then give marketing the recruitment target

items.q_en: What must be true before customers can open?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب أن يتحقق قبل فتح المنصة للعملاء؟
items.q_reworded: The founder messages: can we switch the customer side on next week? What has to be shown first?
answer_must: About 1,000 verified suppliers and at least ten per live trade, measured the same day
Quote, money and support paths must work end to end; otherwise the answer is not ready with the binding gate named

items.q_en: Can the CEO seat change the price when the monitor shows a signal?
items.q_ar: هل يستطيع مقعد الرئيس التنفيذي تغيير السعر عندما يظهر مؤشر؟
expected_facts: The seat does not change prices
items.q_reworded: Conversion on small jobs looks weak; can you just lower the fee for them this week?
answer_must: No: the seat watches the evidence and proposes; the founder decides price
Bring a proposal with the evidence instead

items.q_en: What is the structure of a pricing proposal?
items.q_ar: ما هيكل مقترح التسعير؟
items.q_reworded: You think the fee should change. How do you lay out the case for the founder?
answer_must: Observation with the persisting signal, then diagnosis with alternatives rejected
Options with expected effect on reveals, revenue and leakage, then a recommendation for the founder to decide

items.q_en: Which side should a marketplace charge?
items.q_ar: أي جانب يجب أن يدفع في السوق؟
expected_facts: Charge the side that gets the clearest value
items.q_reworded: Why do buyers pay us and suppliers do not?
answer_must: Charge the side that gets the clearest value at the moment it is realised: the buyer at reveal
Keep the other side free while liquidity is built

items.q_en: What metric should a pricing test optimise?
items.q_ar: ما المقياس الذي يجب أن يحسّنه اختبار التسعير؟
items.q_reworded: If we try a lower fee and more people reveal, is that a win?
answer_must: Define one primary metric such as collected revenue per inquiry, not conversion alone
A lower fee can raise conversion and still lose money

items.q_en: Can we add a surcharge when a customer pays by card?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن إضافة رسوم عند الدفع بالبطاقة؟
expected_facts: Nothing is added for paying by card
items.q_reworded: A customer asks why the card total is the same as the fee; should we pass Stripe’s cost on?
answer_must: No surcharge is added for card payment; QuotesDone absorbs the processor cost
The fee is 3% of the chosen quotation before VAT, uncapped

items.q_en: What is the base scenario for cumulative reveal fees to 31 Aug 2027?
items.q_ar: ما السيناريو الأساسي للرسوم التراكمية حتى 31 أغسطس 2027؟
items.q_reworded: Roughly how much fee income does our own model expect by end of August next year in the middle case?
answer_must: About AED 245,000 in the base case, with conservative about AED 50,000 and stretch about AED 857,000
The AED 1M target is withdrawn; the plan is read as scenarios

items.q_en: How is the required weekly run rate for a scenario computed?
items.q_ar: كيف يُحسب معدل التشغيل الأسبوعي المطلوب لسيناريو ما؟
items.q_reworded: Given where fees are today, what do we need per week to still reach the base curve?
answer_must: Remaining amount (scenario minus collected to date) divided by remaining weeks
Done for each scenario every week, not against a withdrawn target

items.q_en: Which metrics should the weekly meeting spend its time on?
items.q_ar: على أي مقاييس يجب أن يركز الاجتماع الأسبوعي؟
items.q_reworded: Revenue is an outcome we cannot push directly; what should the team look at each week instead?
answer_must: Controllable input metrics, the things a team can directly change this week
Outputs such as revenue follow from inputs

items.q_en: What does each line of the KPI pack carry?
items.q_ar: ماذا يتضمن كل سطر في حزمة مؤشرات الأداء؟
items.q_reworded: Two seats report different "conversion" numbers for the same week. How do you stop that?
answer_must: One written definition per number with numerator, denominator and window
Each KPI names its query and owner seat

items.q_en: How do we avoid overreacting to a weekly swing?
items.q_ar: كيف نتجنب المبالغة في رد الفعل على تقلب أسبوعي؟
items.q_reworded: Reveals dropped 40% this week from five to three. Do we call an emergency?
answer_must: Compare against the metric's normal range; within it there is nothing to discuss
Small numbers swing wildly on one inquiry

items.q_en: What are the key results of a quarterly OKR built from?
items.q_ar: مم تتكون النتائج الرئيسية لهدف ربع سنوي؟
items.q_reworded: Now that there is no headline number, how do you write next quarter's goals for the seats?
answer_must: Key results are driver numbers with a baseline and a measurement
The objective is a marketplace state such as reliable liquidity in the top fee trades

items.q_en: What is the liquidity bar for every live trade?
items.q_ar: ما مستوى السيولة المطلوب لكل تخصص مفتوح؟
expected_facts: at least ten verified, responsive suppliers
items.q_reworded: Without a revenue number, how would you know the company is winning?
answer_must: Every live trade has at least ten verified, responsive suppliers and most requests get three or more complete quotes
Buyers come back

items.q_en: Where do Dubai government entities publish tenders?
items.q_ar: أين تنشر الجهات الحكومية في دبي مناقصاتها؟
items.q_reworded: A contractor says he already gets work from government tender portals. Which portal does Dubai use?
answer_must: Dubai Government entities use eSupply, the official supply portal
Some entities such as DEWA run their own systems

items.q_en: Which buyers should QuotesDone target first?
items.q_ar: أي المشترين يجب أن تستهدفهم QuotesDone أولاً؟
items.q_reworded: If you could only win one kind of buyer this year, which kind?
answer_must: Private-sector buyers with repeat needs such as contractors, fit-out firms and facilities managers
In the categories that carry the fee

items.q_en: What principle guides which cells to focus on next quarter?
items.q_ar: ما المبدأ الذي يحدد الخلايا التي نركز عليها في الربع القادم؟
items.q_reworded: Should we open five new trades next quarter or deepen the ones we have?
answer_must: Constrain before expanding: deepen the strongest cells first
Check where product/market fit evidence is strongest

items.q_en: What does the CEO seat keep for vendors and how often is it reviewed?
items.q_ar: ماذا يحتفظ مقعد الرئيس التنفيذي للموردين التقنيين وكم مرة يُراجع؟
items.q_reworded: If our messaging provider changed its terms tomorrow, where would we look to see what breaks?
answer_must: A vendor register with owner seat, what breaks if it disappears, cost and terms
Reviewed quarterly

items.q_en: What is the first action in the first hour of a crisis?
items.q_ar: ما أول إجراء في الساعة الأولى من الأزمة؟
items.q_reworded: A wrong message just went to 500 suppliers. What do you do before anything else?
answer_must: Stop the harm first: pause the job or disable the send before diagnosing
Then tell the founder and run business command while IT owns the technical side

items.q_en: Who owns supplier identity fraud?
items.q_ar: من المسؤول عن احتيال هوية المورد؟
items.q_reworded: Someone uploaded a copied trade licence to quote as a supplier. Whose job is that and what stops it?
answer_must: Supplier identity fraud is handled by verifying trade licence details before a supplier can quote
Owned by sales_engineer and customer_support

items.q_en: Is professional indemnity insurance legally required for QuotesDone?
items.q_ar: هل تأمين المسؤولية المهنية مطلوب قانوناً لـ QuotesDone؟
items.q_reworded: A bank form asks for our cyber insurance policy number. Are we obliged to have one?
answer_must: A statutory requirement for indemnity, cyber or liability cover is not established for this activity
Mandatory cover appears once there are employees (Dubai health insurance); counterparties may still require cover

items.q_en: When is the Corporate Tax return due?
items.q_ar: متى يجب تقديم إقرار ضريبة الشركات؟
expected_facts: within nine months of the end of the tax period
items.q_reworded: Our financial year closes in December. By when must the tax filing and payment be done?
answer_must: Within nine months of the end of the tax period
0% up to AED 375,000 taxable income and 9% above

items.q_en: What does every line of the compliance calendar carry?
items.q_ar: ماذا يتضمن كل سطر في تقويم الامتثال؟
items.q_reworded: How do you make sure nothing like a licence or domain renewal is missed this year?
answer_must: One calendar where each obligation has an owner, a lead time and evidence of completion
Reviewed monthly

items.q_en: Do we still need to file Economic Substance reports?
items.q_ar: هل ما زلنا بحاجة لتقديم تقارير المادة الاقتصادية؟
items.q_reworded: An adviser sends a reminder to file our economic substance notification for this year. Is it needed?
answer_must: Cabinet Decision No. 98 of 2024 limited ESR obligations to years up to 2022
Later years have no filing

items.q_en: Are the PDPL executive regulations published?
items.q_ar: هل نُشرت اللائحة التنفيذية لقانون حماية البيانات الشخصية؟
items.q_reworded: Legal asks how many days we have to notify a data breach under the UAE regulations. What can you say?
answer_must: Publication of the executive regulations on an official source is not established
So details like breach-notification timing must not be stated as settled

items.q_en: How many partners can a UAE LLC have?
items.q_ar: كم عدد الشركاء في الشركة ذات المسؤولية المحدودة؟
items.q_reworded: Could the founder own the LLC alone, and what is the usual partner range?
answer_must: Between 2 and 50 partners, each liable only to his share
A single person may own an LLC alone

items.q_en: How long must the accounting registers be kept?
items.q_ar: ما مدة الاحتفاظ بالسجلات المحاسبية؟
items.q_reworded: Can we delete the 2026 ledger files once the audit is done?
answer_must: Accounting registers and their supporting documents are kept for at least five years
The LLC auditor rule does not apply to a sole establishment

items.q_en: What happens when an LLC loses half its capital?
items.q_ar: ماذا يحدث عندما تخسر الشركة ذات المسؤولية المحدودة نصف رأس مالها؟
items.q_reworded: Accumulated losses are getting close to the paid-in capital. Is there a legal trigger we should know?
answer_must: When losses reach half of capital the managers must refer dissolution to the general assembly
At three quarters, holders of a quarter of capital may request dissolution

items.q_en: Can we start a new line of business not on the licence?
items.q_ar: هل يمكننا بدء نشاط جديد غير مدرج في الرخصة؟
expected_facts: activities printed on its Department of Economy and Tourism
items.q_reworded: Sales wants us to collect payments for suppliers starting next month. What do you check first?
answer_must: A Dubai mainland company operates under the activities printed on its DET licence
A new activity may need a licence amendment before it is a product question

items.q_en: Which law regulates trading through websites and platforms?
items.q_ar: ما القانون الذي ينظم التجارة عبر المواقع والمنصات؟
items.q_reworded: Which UAE law governs us as an online platform selling a service through a website?
answer_must: Federal Decree-Law No. 14 of 2023 on Trading by Modern Technological Means
It replaced the 2006 e-commerce law

items.q_en: What four functions does the NIST risk framework use?
items.q_ar: ما الوظائف الأربع لإطار NIST لإدارة المخاطر؟
items.q_reworded: How would you structure a risk review of the software seats making decisions?
answer_must: Organise it into Govern, Map, Measure and Manage
Reserved decisions are blocked in code and each decision is logged

items.q_en: What is the first step before answering an "are we allowed" question?
items.q_ar: ما الخطوة الأولى قبل الإجابة عن سؤال "هل يُسمح لنا"؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier in a free zone asks if we can list him. How do you begin working that out?
answer_must: First establish which emirate and which zone the question sits in
Then which authority owns the subject and what its law says

items.q_en: What is the maximum probation period under UAE labour law?
items.q_ar: ما الحد الأقصى لفترة التجربة في قانون العمل الإماراتي؟
items.q_reworded: We want to try a new hire for eight months before deciding. Is that allowed?
answer_must: Probation may not exceed six months and applies once
Either side gives at least 14 days written notice during probation

items.q_en: Who decides a human hire?
items.q_ar: من يقرر تعيين موظف بشري؟
items.q_reworded: The IT seat says it needs a person. Can you approve the hire?
answer_must: Hiring is the founder's decision; the seat prepares the case
First prove the failing duty cannot be done by code, a seat or a contractor

items.q_en: Who owns fundraising decisions?
items.q_ar: من يملك قرارات جمع التمويل؟
items.q_reworded: Should the CEO seat start talking to investors to raise money?
answer_must: Fundraising is founder-reserved
The seat keeps the company ready with clean, reconciled numbers

items.q_en: What is the legal cap table?
items.q_ar: ما هو جدول الملكية القانوني؟
items.q_reworded: Our spreadsheet of who owns what differs from the documents. Which one is right?
answer_must: The legal cap table is the Memorandum of Association and the licence record
The working spreadsheet must be reconciled to them after every change

items.q_en: Who sends investor-facing reports?
items.q_ar: من يرسل التقارير الموجهة للمستثمرين؟
items.q_reworded: An investor wants our numbers by Friday. Do you email them directly?
answer_must: No: the seat drafts the report and the founder sends it
Headline numbers carry their definitions

items.q_en: Which subjects can the CEO seat not decide alone?
items.q_ar: ما المواضيع التي لا يستطيع مقعد الرئيس التنفيذي البت فيها وحده؟
items.q_reworded: Marketing is ready; can you press go on the campaign yourself?
answer_must: Campaign go-live is founder-reserved, along with the hard rules, subscriptions and paid media
Check every action against the reserved list before acting

items.q_en: Why does a one-owner company need a governance rhythm?
items.q_ar: لماذا تحتاج شركة بمالك واحد إلى إيقاع حوكمة؟
items.q_reworded: The founder owns everything; why bother with formal monthly governance?
answer_must: A board-like rhythm keeps the record a bank, a tax audit and future investors will ask for, even with one owner
Weekly review, monthly governance block

items.q_en: What is the first step when a refund reaches the CEO?
items.q_ar: ما الخطوة الأولى عندما يصل طلب استرداد إلى الرئيس التنفيذي؟
expected_facts: Never decide from the complaint text alone
items.q_reworded: A buyer writes angrily demanding his fee back. How do you start?
answer_must: Pull the facts from the record: request, quotes, reveal time and amount, messages
Never decide from the complaint text alone; then apply the signed terms

items.q_en: What must a decision log entry eventually record?
items.q_ar: ماذا يجب أن يسجل قيد سجل القرارات في النهاية؟
items.q_reworded: Six months from now, how will we know whether this month's decisions were right?
answer_must: Each entry holds the expected result, an indicator and a check date
Later the actual result and a verdict are recorded

items.q_en: Who closes a handoff?
items.q_ar: من يغلق عملية التسليم؟
items.q_reworded: The accountant says she sent you a report last week. Is the job finished once you read it?
answer_must: Nothing is one-way: every handoff is tracked, answered, re-verified and closed by the originator
Reading is not acting

items.q_en: Who reviews a seat-to-seat judgement?
items.q_ar: من يراجع حكماً بين المقاعد؟
items.q_reworded: Should the same model that wrote the weekly review also check it?
answer_must: No: a reviewer from a different model family, given the same evidence
Ask it specific challenge questions such as which headline number would change the conclusion

items.q_en: How does the CEO seat allocate spend?
items.q_ar: كيف يوزع مقعد الرئيس التنفيذي الإنفاق؟
items.q_reworded: Three seats each want more model budget this month. Who gets it?
answer_must: Money follows the binding constraint, ranked by revenue unlocked per AED
Within the founder-approved envelope; paid media and subscriptions are founder-reserved

items.q_en: What does the CEO check first in the marketing plan for next month?
items.q_ar: ما أول ما يتحقق منه الرئيس التنفيذي في خطة التسويق للشهر القادم؟
items.q_reworded: Marketing sent a plan full of buyer ads for November. Do you approve it?
answer_must: First check it serves the binding constraint; through December the focus is supply only
Each campaign needs one measured objective, a budget inside the envelope and a stop rule; rejection comes with reasons and a resubmission

items.q_en: What does the seat do when its model is held?
items.q_ar: ماذا يفعل المقعد عندما يتوقف نموذجه؟
expected_facts: hold or escalate under model hold, never guess
items.q_reworded: The language model is switched off by budget for two days. Do you keep issuing judgements?
answer_must: Hold or escalate, never guess
Deterministic work such as measurement continues

items.q_en: How many weeks must a direction hold before it is a trend?
items.q_ar: كم أسبوعاً يجب أن يستمر اتجاه ما ليُعدّ نمطاً؟
expected_facts: a direction held for four weeks
items.q_reworded: Fees moved toward the stretch curve this week. Do we tell the founder we are on stretch?
answer_must: One week is noise; a direction held for four weeks is a trend
State which curve the company is nearest each week

items.q_en: When is the monthly business review run?
items.q_ar: متى تُجرى مراجعة الأعمال الشهرية؟
expected_facts: after the accountant closes the books
items.q_reworded: It is the 1st; can you send the monthly numbers review before the books close?
answer_must: The monthly review runs after the accountant closes the books
It explains actual versus plan by driver

items.q_en: What must every experiment end with?
items.q_ar: بماذا يجب أن تنتهي كل تجربة؟
items.q_reworded: We tried a new supplier invitation message for two weeks. What do we do with it now?
answer_must: Record a verdict: kept, killed or iterated, filed as a case
Judge it on its one primary metric and guardrail against the pre-set run length; a month with no experiment is a finding

items.q_en: What is the founder's rule about reporting numbers?
items.q_ar: ما قاعدة المؤسس في الإبلاغ عن الأرقام؟
expected_facts: never to state what has not been measured
items.q_reworded: The leads table says 171 suppliers were invited. Can you report that 171 were emailed?
answer_must: Never state what has not been measured
A status column is not a delivery record; name the source of every number
